name: full_python_node
text:
apiVersion: v3.2.0
kind: DataContract
id: analytics.python_node
name: python_node
version: "0"
tags: [orders, daily]
description:
  purpose: Order lines with their EUR amount, rebuilt from the order and rate tables.
  usage: Feeds the daily revenue dashboards and the finance exports.
  limitations: Amounts of the last hour are provisional until the rates arrive.
team:
  name: service-py
roles:
  - role: analytics-reader
    access: read
    description: Reads the table for the dashboards.
slaProperties:
  - property: freshness
    value: 1
    unit: d
    description: The table is rebuilt every day before 06:00 UTC.
support:
  - channel: data-platform
    tool: slack
    url: https://example.com/support/data-platform
    description: Questions about this table.
authoritativeDefinitions:
  - type: businessDefinition
    url: https://example.com/glossary/order-line
customProperties:
  - {vendor: continuo, property: service, value: service-py}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: kind, value: python-node}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: schedule, value: daily}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: criticality, value: CORE}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: timeoutMinutes, value: 120}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: script, value: scripts/python_node.py}
  - vendor: continuo
    property: readQueries
    value:
      orders: select order_id, line_no, customer_email, amount, seen_at from analytics.orders
      rates: select currency, rate_to_eur from analytics.fx_rates
  - {vendor: continuo, property: extraColumns, value: warn}
  - vendor: continuo
    property: config
    value: {batch_size: 5000, compression: zstd, tags: [a, b]}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: modeType, value: upsert}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: assets, value: [assets/currencies.csv, assets/rounding.json]}
  - {vendor: lotse, property: schedule, value: weekly}
schema:
  - name: python_node
    physicalType: table
    description: One row per order line.
    properties:
      - name: order_id
        physicalType: BIGINT
        description: The order the line belongs to.
        required: true
        unique: false
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        classification: internal
        examples: [1001, 1002]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.orders.order_id
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "order_id > 0"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: warnIf, value: ">= 1"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: errorIf, value: "> 10"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: failCalc, value: "count(*)"}
      - name: line_no
        physicalType: INTEGER
        description: The position of the line in the order, from 1.
        required: true
        unique: false
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 2
        classification: public
        examples: [1, 2]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.orders.line_no
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "line_no >= 1"}
      - name: customer_email
        physicalType: "VARCHAR(128)"
        description: The email of the customer who placed the order.
        required: false
        unique: false
        classification: restricted
        examples: [ada@example.com]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.customers.email
        quality:
          - metric: invalidValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "customer_email is not null"}
      - name: amount
        physicalType: "NUMERIC(12,2)"
        description: The amount of the line in EUR.
        required: true
        unique: false
        classification: internal
        examples: [19.99, 5]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.order_amounts.amount
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "amount is not null"}
      - name: weight
        physicalType: DOUBLE PRECISION
        description: The weight of the line in kilograms.
        required: false
        unique: false
        classification: public
        examples: [0.25]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.products.weight
        quality:
          - metric: missingValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "weight > 0"}
      - name: seen_at
        physicalType: TIMESTAMP
        description: When the line was last seen.
        required: false
        unique: false
        classification: public
        examples: ["2026-11-14T08:30:00"]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.orders.seen_at
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "seen_at is not null"}

text:
apiVersion: v3.2.0
kind: DataContract
id: analytics.python_csv
name: python_csv
version: "0"
tags: [orders, csv]
description:
  purpose: The orders export that the shop publishes as a CSV file, loaded as it is.
  usage: Reconciles the shop's orders with the ledger.
  limitations: The file is replaced once a day, so the table lags by up to 24 hours.
team:
  name: service-py
roles:
  - role: reconciliation-reader
    access: read
    description: Reads the table for the ledger reconciliation.
slaProperties:
  - property: freshness
    value: 1
    unit: d
    description: The table is reloaded every day.
support:
  - channel: data-platform
    tool: email
    url: mailto:data-platform@example.com
    description: Questions about this table.
authoritativeDefinitions:
  - type: businessDefinition
    url: https://example.com/glossary/shop-order
customProperties:
  - {vendor: continuo, property: service, value: service-py}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: kind, value: python-csv}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: schedule, value: daily}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: criticality, value: SECONDARY}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: timeoutMinutes, value: 30}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: csvSource, value: "s3://continuo-dev/static-files/full/orders.csv"}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: extraColumns, value: warn}
  - vendor: continuo
    property: config
    value: {batch_size: 2500, null_marker: "NULL"}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: modeType, value: replace}
  - {vendor: atlan, property: glossaryTerm, value: Shop order}
schema:
  - name: python_csv
    physicalType: table
    description: One row per order of the export.
    properties:
      - name: order_id
        physicalType: INTEGER
        description: The order number in the shop.
        required: true
        unique: true
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        classification: internal
        examples: [1, 2]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.orders.order_id
        quality:
          - metric: duplicateValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "order_id > 0"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: warnIf, value: ">= 1"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: errorIf, value: "> 10"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: failCalc, value: "count(*)"}
      - name: customer
        physicalType: "VARCHAR(64)"
        description: The name of the customer.
        required: false
        unique: false
        classification: restricted
        examples: [Ada Lovelace]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.customers.name
        quality:
          - metric: missingValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "customer is not null"}
      - name: amount
        physicalType: DOUBLE PRECISION
        description: The amount of the order in EUR.
        required: false
        unique: false
        classification: internal
        examples: [19.99, 5]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.order_amounts.amount
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "amount >= 0"}
      - name: ordered_on
        physicalType: DATE
        description: The day of the order.
        required: false
        unique: false
        classification: public
        examples: ["2026-11-14"]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.calendar.day
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "ordered_on is not null"}

name: full_python_api
text:
apiVersion: v3.2.0
kind: DataContract
id: analytics.python_api
name: python_api
version: "0"
tags: [rates, api]
description:
  purpose: Exchange rates that a script fetches from the rates API and appends every hour.
  usage: Joins the order lines with the rate of their day.
  limitations: The API publishes no rate on weekends, so Monday carries Friday's rate.
team:
  name: service-py
roles:
  - role: rates-reader
    access: read
    description: Reads the table for the revenue models.
slaProperties:
  - property: freshness
    value: 2
    unit: h
    description: A new rate is appended every hour.
support:
  - channel: data-platform
    tool: slack
    url: https://example.com/support/data-platform
    description: Questions about this table.
authoritativeDefinitions:
  - type: businessDefinition
    url: https://example.com/glossary/exchange-rate
customProperties:
  - {vendor: continuo, property: service, value: service-py}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: kind, value: python-api}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: schedule, value: hourly}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: criticality, value: REGULATORY}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: timeoutMinutes, value: 60}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: script, value: scripts/python_api.py}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: extraColumns, value: warn}
  - vendor: continuo
    property: config
    value: {batch_size: 500, retries: 3}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: secretRef, value: continuo-api-rates}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: modeType, value: append}
  - {vendor: continuo, property: assets, value: [assets/currencies.json]}
  - {vendor: atlan, property: glossaryTerm, value: Exchange rate}
schema:
  - name: python_api
    physicalType: table
    description: One row per currency and fetch time.
    properties:
      - name: currency
        physicalType: "CHAR(3)"
        description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency.
        required: true
        unique: false
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        classification: public
        examples: [USD, GBP]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.currencies.code
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "currency is not null"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: warnIf, value: ">= 1"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: errorIf, value: "> 10"}
              - {vendor: continuo, property: failCalc, value: "count(*)"}
      - name: fetched_at
        physicalType: TIMESTAMP
        description: When the script fetched the rate.
        required: true
        unique: false
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 2
        classification: public
        examples: ["2026-11-14T08:00:00"]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.fetches.fetched_at
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "fetched_at is not null"}
      - name: rate_to_eur
        physicalType: "NUMERIC(18,8)"
        description: The value of one unit of the currency in EUR.
        required: true
        unique: false
        classification: public
        examples: [1.0837, 0.8581]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.rates.rate_to_eur
        quality:
          - metric: nullValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "rate_to_eur > 0"}
      - name: is_estimate
        physicalType: BOOLEAN
        description: True when the API marks the rate as an estimate.
        required: false
        unique: false
        classification: public
        examples: [true, false]
        relationships:
          - to: analytics.rates.is_estimate
        quality:
          - metric: missingValues
            mustBe: 0
            customProperties:
              - {vendor: continuo, property: where, value: "is_estimate is not null"}

description.limitations: The API publishes no rate on weekends, so Monday carries Friday's rate.
description.purpose: Exchange rates that a script fetches from the rates API and appends every hour.

properties.name: currency

properties.name: fetched_at

properties.description: The value of one unit of the currency in EUR.
properties.name: rate_to_eur
